units.source_text: 写信日期都是临死前的日子。

en.t: The dates on the letters were all from the days just before his death.

units.source_text: 1947年5月几乎是每天一封，从东京寄给柏木的。

en.t: In May 1947, almost one letter a day had been sent from Tokyo to Kashiwagi.

units.source_text: 他没有给我寄过一封信。

en.t: He had never sent a single letter to me.

units.source_text: 这样看来，他回到东京的翌日就每天给柏木写信了。

en.t: Seen this way, he had begun writing to Kashiwagi every day from the day after he returned to Tokyo.

units.source_text: 字迹无疑是鹤川的，字体带棱带角，十分稚拙。

en.t: The handwriting was unmistakably Tsurukawa's, angular and very immature.
I could not help feeling a little jealous.

units.source_text: 鹤川在我面前没有任何虚伪，总是表现出透明的感情，

en.t: In front of me, Tsurukawa showed no falseness at all and always revealed transparent feelings,

units.source_text: 且偶然还说几句柏木的坏话，非难我同柏木的交往，

en.t: and now and then he even spoke ill of Kashiwagi and criticized my association with him,

units.source_text: 而他自己却一味对我隐瞒与柏木之间这样亲密的交情。

en.t: yet he himself kept persistently hiding from me such an intimate friendship with Kashiwagi.
